profile.basis: Both digital curves admit a constant ratiometric NTC pullup across XT660 resistance specifications. TDM900 fail-safe values match both fallback codes under this formula.
profile.conflict: XT660 2004 manual specifies coolant fail-safe 80 C; this formula gives 60 C. TDM900 specifies 60 C. This does not identify this dump as TDM900 firmware or prove its board matches either manual.
requires: NTC to ground with constant pullup to ADC reference

coolant_profile.status: owner-corroborated Celsius encoding; not a calibrated sensor accuracy certificate
coolant_profile.basis: ECU emits floor(code*5/8), capped at 149. Earlier Yamaha-DataLogger subtracts 30 from the received byte. On 2026-10-30 the owner confirmed checking that conversion on their XT660 and confirmed the logger output was Celsius.
coolant_profile.limits: No paired measurement values, accuracy, temperature range or ECU part number were supplied. The 80 C manual fallback discrepancy remains separate; this image substitutes code144, which encodes 60 C.

assumptions: Ideal 10-bit ratiometric ADC; ADC bin width 1/1024; NTC to ground; constant pullup; published sensor resistance intervals. Output tolerance covers one code plus the next input group (one ADC count for coolant, four for IAT because two input bits are discarded). This is a consistency test, not uniqueness proof or a component measurement.
